## Scope gate (read first)
Cerevex is used internally only, for now. It has no marketing, no qualified outcome, and no channels (agency owner, 2026-09-29).
- Every marketing skill declines Cerevex marketing work and says why: ads, landing pages, SEO, AI search, schema, social, video, lifecycle or sales messaging, offers, competitor research, marketing plans, reports, and lead or tracking audits.
- Reply shape: `declined: Cerevex is an internal tool, not marketed (cerevex profile status). Ask the agency owner to change the status to start marketing work.`
- Still allowed: Cerevex as the system where Tharros records recommendations and approvals (`/home/box/agent-data/workflows/tharros-shared-references/references/cerevex-recommendation-format.md`), and plain-language edits to internal product UI or help text when the agency owner asks (`no-slop-copy`).
- Only the agency owner lifts this gate, by changing `status` in this file.
